title: Rex and the Game on the Rug
synopsis: Rex worries that Jack will stop playing with his old toy truck when he becomes five; an afternoon building a cardboard rocket truck together gives him his answer.
continuity_state: Before: Jack's birthday is tomorrow. The red four-wheeled wagon is finished and hidden. Rex has his longtime repaired wooden dump truck and the old cardboard rug-play toys. After: Rex learns Jack still enjoys old games after the Moon journey, with ideas for more. The birthday gift remains hidden and the picnic is still tomorrow. Jack is nearly five.
